palisade.name: Palisade
palisade.examine: Sharpened logs, lashed tight. Somebody here expects company and does not want it.

palisade_post.name: Palisade post
palisade_post.examine: A corner post as thick as a man, its point blackened in a fire to harden it.

camp_gate.name: Camp gate
camp_gate.examine: The gate of Thornwatch Camp. The red cloth is the Sisters' thorn; the gate itself was burned in the retreat and never rebuilt.

pavilion.name: Great pavilion
pavilion.examine: The captain's pavilion: two ridges of canvas, patched where the arrows went through.

ridge_tent.name: Canvas tent
ridge_tent.examine: A soldier's tent, two sleep in it and four snore.

covered_wagon.name: Covered wagon
covered_wagon.examine: A caravan wagon, its hood bleached by three summers on the road east. It has not moved since the pass closed.

handcart.name: Handcart
handcart.examine: Two wheels, two sacks, and nobody willing to push it.

dry_wall.name: Dry-stone wall
dry_wall.examine: Old field stones piled without mortar, older than the camp. The camp just leans on it.

herb_table.name: Healer's table
herb_table.examine: Jars of salve, a mortar still green inside, and bundles of moor herbs drying overhead.

tripod_brazier.name: Brazier
tripod_brazier.examine: An iron bowl of coals on three legs. Something in this cave has learned to keep it fed.

archery_butt.name: Archery butt
archery_butt.examine: A straw target, shot through so often the middle is mostly holes held together by habit.

skull_stone.name: Skull stone
skull_stone.examine: A face hacked into the rock and daubed red. A warning, or an invitation, depending on who carved it.

bone_pile.name: Bones
bone_pile.examine: Picked clean. The small teeth marks are the worrying part.

bedroll.name: Bedroll
bedroll.examine: A blanket and a sack of straw. Somebody sleeps here when the watch lets them.

spear_rack.name: Spear rack
spear_rack.examine: Three spears, sharpened yesterday, and a gap where a fourth was.

hollow_oak.name: The hollow oak
hollow_oak.examine: An oak older than the abbey, split open down the front. Something pale is tucked in the dark of the hollow.

gibbet_cage.name: Gibbet cage
gibbet_cage.examine: An iron cage on a gallows arm, its lock as big as a fist.

burnt_wall.name: Burned wall
burnt_wall.examine: What is left of a house wall. The stones are still warm, which they should not be.

charred_beam.name: Charred beams
charred_beam.examine: Roof beams, burned through and fallen. They crumble when you step on them.

ember_heap.name: Smouldering rubble
ember_heap.examine: A heap of what used to be a house. It has been burning for a month and shows no sign of stopping.

ruined_tower.name: The drowned tower
ruined_tower.examine: A round tower sunk to its knees in the bog. Its top is gone; its cellars, they say, go down a long way.

bog_pool.name: Bog pool
bog_pool.examine: Black water, still as glass. You cannot see the bottom, and you do not want to try.

reed_clump.name: Reeds
reed_clump.examine: Bulrushes, taller than you. Something moves through them now and then.

abbey_wall.name: Abbey wall
abbey_wall.examine: The Thornwatch's abbey wall: three hundred years of good masonry, and now nobody on it.

abbey_wall_broken.name: Broken wall
abbey_wall_broken.examine: Something came through here. It did not use the gate.

abbey_gate.name: Abbey gate
abbey_gate.examine: The gate of the Thornwatch abbey, its thorn banner still hanging over an empty arch.

cloister_arch.name: Cloister arch
cloister_arch.examine: An arch of the cloister walk. The sisters' names are carved on every column, small.

abbey_altar.name: Altar
abbey_altar.examine: The abbey's altar. Someone has lit the candles again. Someone who is not a sister.

sarcophagus.name: Stone coffin
sarcophagus.examine: A sister of the Thornwatch, buried under the abbey. The lid has been pushed aside from inside.
